# DejaVu fonts

No font files are included. `tablet/font_aa.h` holds glyph bitmaps rendered
from DejaVu Sans and DejaVu Sans ExtraLight by `scripts/genfont_aa.py`; the
laptop side (`host/theme.py`) loads the DejaVu fonts installed on the system.
The DejaVu fonts are under the Bitstream Vera license with DejaVu changes in
the public domain; the full text (Debian's copyright file of fonts-dejavu-core)
is in LICENSE.txt.
